svg.title: ORM v6.17.0, New Usage Metrics & Direct Connections in GA for Prisma Postgres
svg.desc: A beam of light running from a row of Postgres tools — Drizzle, Kysely, TypeORM, psql — into a Prisma Postgres database drawn as stacked planes, marking direct connections as generally available. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, Postgres yellow accent.
